title: Evaluating the Experience of LGBTQ+ People Using Large Language Model Based Chatbots for Mental Health Support

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of semi-structured interviews with 31 users (18 LGBTQ+ and 13 non-LGBTQ+), using open coding to evaluate users' lived experiences and the chatbots' lack of nuanced understanding, generic responses, and potentially harmful advice regarding LGBTQ+-specific challenges like homophobia, transphobia, and coming out.

primary_bias_target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
